events.title: Free guided tour - Brisbane Botanic Gardens Mt Coot-tha
events.location: Mt Coot-tha Visitor Information Centre, Brisbane Botanic Gardens Mt Coot-tha
events.source: Brisbane City Council / Brisbane Botanic Gardens
events.description: Explore the diverse plant collections and natural beauty of Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens on this free guided walking tour, led by a knowledgeable volunteer. Learn about horticulture, local flora, and the garden's history.

events.title: Free guided tour - City Botanic Gardens
events.location: City Botanic Gardens Information Kiosk, Brisbane City Botanic Gardens
events.source: Brisbane City Council / City Botanic Gardens
events.description: Discover the history and horticulture of Brisbane's original botanic gardens on this free guided walking tour, starting from the Information Kiosk. Learn about the diverse plant species and the garden's role in the city.

events.title: Self-Publishing Bootcamp with Ellie Marney
events.description: An intensive two-day bootcamp for aspiring authors, covering the essentials of self-publishing. Led by Ellie Marney, learn about editing, formatting, marketing, and distributing your work independently.

events.title: GRIMM – Tales from the Brothers Grimm
events.description: Shake & Stir Theatre Co. presents a reimagining of classic Brothers Grimm fairytales, blending dark fantasy and theatrical magic in an immersive stage production at QPAC.

events.title: Macbeth
events.description: Shakespeare's classic tragedy, Macbeth, presented by Shake & Stir Theatre Co. Experience the compelling tale of ambition, prophecy, and power in a contemporary staging at QPAC.

events.title: BEETLEJUICE THE MUSICAL
events.description: The hit Broadway musical based on Tim Burton's beloved film, Beetlejuice, comes to QPAC. Join the irreverent ghost with the most for a night of ghoulishly good fun and catchy tunes.

events.title: Alfie Boe
events.description: Acclaimed British tenor Alfie Boe performs live at QPAC, showcasing his powerful vocals and repertoire of Broadway hits, classical standards, and contemporary songs.

events.title: Ella Mai
events.description: Grammy-winning R&B singer Ella Mai performs her soulful hits and latest tracks in an intimate gig at The Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Leon Thomas: Mutts Don't Heel Tour
events.description: Artist Leon Thomas brings his 'Mutts Don't Heel' tour to Brisbane, delivering a live performance of his unique sound and captivating stage presence.

events.title: Gary Owen 'No Hard Feelings' Tour
events.description: Veteran comedian Gary Owen brings his 'No Hard Feelings' stand-up tour to Brisbane, promising a night of relatable observations and sharp humor.

events.title: The Jungle Giants
events.description: Brisbane's own indie-pop sensations, The Jungle Giants, return to their hometown stage for a high-energy live performance of their dance-inducing hits.

events.title: Matt Corby
events.description: Australian singer-songwriter Matt Corby captivates audiences with his soulful voice and intricate arrangements, performing live at The Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Tamil-Language Volunteer Guided Tour QAG Highlights
events.description: Join a volunteer-led tour of the Queensland Art Gallery's highlights, conducted in Tamil. Explore key artworks and gain cultural insights through a unique linguistic lens.
